name: pulseward-hms
description: PulseWard Hospital Management System - A comprehensive solution for managing hospital operations, patient care, and administrative tasks.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,patient,clinician,admin,ops" -c "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "node --no-warnings services/api-gateway/src" "pnpm --dir apps/patient-portal dev" "pnpm --dir apps/clinician-portal dev" "pnpm --dir apps/admin-console dev" "pnpm --dir apps/operations-dashboard dev"
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --dir apps/admin-console build && pnpm --dir apps/clinician-portal build && pnpm --dir apps/operations-dashboard build && pnpm --dir apps/patient-portal build
scripts.build:apps:ci: pnpm --dir apps/admin-console install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/admin-console build && pnpm --dir apps/clinician-portal install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/clinician-portal build && pnpm --dir apps/operations-dashboard install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/operations-dashboard build && pnpm --dir apps/patient-portal install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/patient-portal build
scripts.quality:check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run contracts:check -- --strict
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:quick && pnpm run contracts:check -- --strict

author: VKrishna04
